info.title: PowerUtils.BenchmarkDotnet.Reporter
info.description: Tool to analyze and compare .NET benchmark reports

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Compare two BenchmarkDotNet reports and produce a diff report.

options.name: --baseline
options.description: Path to the folder or file with Baseline report.

options.name: --target
options.description: Path to the folder or file with target reports.

options.name: --threshold-mean
options.description: Throw an error when the mean threshold is met. Examples: 5%, 10ms, 10us, 100ns, 1s.

options.name: --threshold-allocation
options.description: Throw an error when the allocation threshold is met. Examples: 5%, 10b, 10kb, 100mb, 1gb.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format for the report. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory to export the diff report. Default is current directory. [default: ./BenchmarkReporter]

options.name: --fail-on-warnings
options.description: Exit with error code when the comparison generates any warnings. [default: False]

options.name: --fail-on-threshold-hit
options.description: Exit with error code when any threshold is hit during comparison. [default: False]
